title: amygdalus persica var. compressa
intro: Amygdalus persica var. compressa, commonly known as Dried Apricot, is a variety of the apricot fruit that has been dried and compressed into a compact form. The health benefits of Dried Apricot include high fiber content, which can help regulate bowel movements and support healthy digestion, as well as being a good source of vitamin A and potassium. The therapeutic actions of Dried Apricot include its antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and inflammation, and its ability to soothe digestive issues and reduce anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Dried Apricot include carotenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
